correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the left-loadedness definitions and all quantifiers. For \(m\ge3\) it derives the exact consecutive ratio of symmetric binomial masses, factors its comparison with one, proves the missing endpoint inequality by a separate unimodality argument for \(F_m(N)\), and then transfers the single sign change to \(\alpha_i\). The boundary \(n=2m\) and small means \(m=1,2\) are handled separately. Simmons inequality is independently corroborated by the motivating full text and the Perrin–Redside summary. Finite exact computation is supplemental only.
